question: Câu 601: He ______ unleaded gas and left on his journey.
explanation: filled up with sth: đổ đầy với cái gì. Có tân ngữ nên dùng filled up with.

question: Câu 602: I will return Bob's pen to him the next time I ______ him.
explanation: Mệnh đề thời gian trong tương lai dùng hiện tại đơn: the next time + S + V (hiện tại đơn).

question: Câu 603: Unfortunately, I had to ______ Bob for his poor performance.
explanation: tell sb off for doing st: quở trách, phê bình ai vì làm gì.

question: Câu 604: As humans are destroying their own planet, the ______ for a new homeland in the universe is essential.
explanation: the quest for: cuộc tìm kiếm cái gì.

question: Câu 605: ______ broken several world records in swimming.
options: She is said that she has
explanation: Cấu trúc bị động tường thuật: S + is said to have + VpII (đã làm gì trong quá khứ).

question: Câu 606: Our school ______ for the summer holidays on the 10th of July.
explanation: break up for the holidays: nghỉ học để bắt đầu kỳ nghỉ.

question: Câu 607: The gap between ______ rich and ______ poor in developing countries is a very big problem to solve.
explanation: the + adj = nhóm người: the rich, the poor.

question: Câu 608: Next week is Tet Holiday, I ______ with my family for the next 5 days.
explanation: Tương lai tiếp diễn: will be + V-ing (hành động kéo dài trong tương lai).

question: Câu 609: We all creased ______ when Nick walked in wearing a skirt.
explanation: crease up: cười rất nhiều.

question: Câu 610: Nowadays, ______ teenagers use the internet instead of reading books.
explanation: more and more + N: ngày càng nhiều...

question: Câu 611: You can activate your digital devices by buttons or voice recognition.
explanation: activate (kích hoạt) << switch off (tắt).

question: Câu 612: She was expecting 50 people to come the press conference, but half of them never ______.
explanation: show up: xuất hiện, đến tham dự.

question: Câu 613: Within a week on display at the exhibition, the painting was hailed as a masterpiece.
explanation: masterpiece = an excellent work of art (kiệt tác).

question: Câu 614: Candidates are requested to ________ the form to the admissions officer by July 25th.
explanation: hand in: nộp.

question: Câu 615: John: “Do you mind if I smoke?” Lisa: “______.”
explanation: Đáp lại lịch sự khi cho phép: No, go right ahead.

question: Câu 616: Sue: “These flowers are so beautiful! Thank you very much, Bill.” Bill: “______!”
explanation: Đáp lại lời cảm ơn: Don't mention it.

question: Câu 617: Nick: “I’m really tired. I’m taking next week off.” Michael: “_________”
options: Well, you must be telling a lie!
Take care, my love. Have a nice weekend!
That sounds like a good idea. The break will do you good.
Really? I don’t know what you are going to do.
explanation: Đồng tình và khuyến khích nghỉ ngơi.

question: Câu 618: Nam: “As women live longer than men, should they retire later?” Lan: “_________”
options: When women are retired, they want to enjoy life.
When men are retired, they still want to continue working.
The government is still discussing the retirement age.
I don't think so. Physically, they are weaker and they need to retire earlier.
explanation: Phản bác hợp lý dựa trên lý do thể chất.

question: Câu 619: a. Why don't you move to the downtown area? b. I guess I have no choice. c. Yeah. That's quite a lot of money. d. Because of the cost. You know, 2000 dollars for renting a house. e. I am really fed up with commuting such a long distance every day.
explanation: Thứ tự logic: than phiền → gợi ý → lý do → đồng tình → chấp nhận.

question: Câu 620: a. That's unbelievable—such dedication at their age is inspiring. b. It makes you wonder what they'll accomplish in the future. c. I know, the creativity here is just incredible. Did you see the robotics team's demo? d. Absolutely, this competition is full of future leaders and innovators. e. Yes, their robot's precision was mind-blowing! f. And I heard one of the students built it in just two months. g. I am really impressed by how many talented students are attending this competition.
explanation: Thứ tự logic: ấn tượng chung → hỏi chi tiết → trả lời → bổ sung → khen ngợi → suy nghĩ tương lai → kết luận.

question: Câu 621: a. That sounds interesting! I've never tried it before. What do I need to get started? b. I'm really into painting. It's a great way to unwind and be creative. c. Just some basic tools, seeds, and a bit of patience. It's really rewarding. d. I've been thinking about picking up a new hobby. Any suggestions? e. I'll look into it. What about you? What's your favorite hobby? f. How about gardening? It's relaxing and you can grow your own plants.
options: d - e - b - f - a - c
d - f - e - b - a - c
d - a - c - e - b - f
d - f - a - c - e - b
explanation: Thứ tự: hỏi gợi ý → đề xuất làm vườn → hỏi cách bắt đầu → hướng dẫn → hỏi lại sở thích → trả lời.

question: Câu 622: a. They are used for my presentation today. b. Yes. I had to stay up late last night. c. What are these handouts for? d. Oh. They look great. You must have spent so much time on it.
explanation: Thứ tự: hỏi mục đích → trả lời → khen → xác nhận đã mất công.

question: Câu 623: I couldn't help admiring the way he managed to finish the programme even after such a bad fall.
options: The way he finished the programme was certainly admirable, as the fall had shaken him up badly.
It was really a very bad fall, but somehow he was still able to finish the programme and I had to admire him for that.
In spite of the fall, he should have finished the programme and we could have admired him for that.
I really admire the way he got up after the fall and completed the programme.
explanation: Viết lại câu gần nghĩa nhất với “couldn't help admiring” và “even after such a bad fall”.

question: Câu 624: Newspaper publishers in the United States have estimated ________ reads a newspaper every day.
options: nearly 80 percent of the adult population who
it is nearly 80 percent of the adult population
that nearly 80 percent of the adult population who
that nearly 80 percent of the adult population
explanation: estimated that + clause. Không thừa who.

question: Câu 625: I don't care ______ money. Money can't buy happiness.
explanation: care about sth: quan tâm đến cái gì.

question: Câu 626: Look at the sky, it is going to rain. Thus, you must bring along a raincoat.
explanation: must mang nghĩa bắt buộc quá mạnh. Nên dùng should/had better (lời khuyên).

question: Câu 627: Edward booked the tickets without asking us first. It was wrong of him to do so.
options: Before asking us, Edward should have booked the tickets.
Edward need not have asked us before he booked the tickets.
Edward booked the tickets after he had asked us about them.
Edward shouldn't have booked the ticket without asking us first.
explanation: shouldn't have + VpII: đáng lẽ không nên làm gì (đã làm sai).

question: Câu 628: He badly suffered cyberbullying himself. He realized the true dangers of social media only then.
options: Not until he had badly suffered cyberbullying himself did he realize the true dangers of social media.
Such was his suffering of cyberbullying that he didn't realize the true dangers of social media.
Only when he had realized the true dangers of social media did he badly suffer cyberbullying himself.
But for his terrible suffering of cyberbullying, he wouldn't realize the true dangers of social media.
explanation: Cấu trúc Not until + clause + đảo ngữ.

question: Câu 629: There used to be a theatre here. It was torn down a few years ago.
options: Since there used to be a theatre here, it was torn down a few years ago.
The theatre which was torn down a few years ago had not been used.
There used to be a theatre here, but it was torn down a few years ago.
A theatre was used here, but it was torn down a few years ago.
explanation: used to + but: đã từng có nhưng giờ không còn.

question: Câu 630: She was the first woman in the Philippines. She was elected as the president of the country.
options: She was the first woman who is elected as the president of the Philippines.
She was the first woman elected as the president of the Philippines.
She was the first woman being elected as the president of the Philippines.
She was the first woman to be elected as the president of the Philippines.
explanation: the first/last/only + to V: người đầu tiên làm gì.

question: Câu 631: ... are willing to spend to (631) ______ the look they want...
explanation: achieve the look: đạt được vẻ ngoài mong muốn.

question: Câu 632: (632) ______ interesting piece of information coming out of the study is that...
explanation: Another + N số ít: một ... khác.

question: Câu 633: ... more concerned about appearance, (633) ______ they all agreed that the clothes should fit them properly.
explanation: although: mặc dù (tương phản).

question: Câu 634: All the girls (634) ______ were interviewed shop for clothes regularly...
explanation: who thay thế chủ ngữ chỉ người.

question: Câu 635: They also see it as a social (635) ______ and going round the shops with their friends...
explanation: a social activity: hoạt động xã hội.

question: Câu 636: What is the main idea of the reading?
options: Children often become like their parents.
Children need to play sports in school.
Playing sports may have negative results.
Some sports can cause health problems.
explanation: Ý chính: chơi thể thao có thể gây ra tác động tiêu cực.

question: Câu 637: Which is NOT TRUE according to the passage?
options: Adults are the main cause of children's aggression in sports.
Children usually respect parents and coaches so they are powerful teachers.
Adults should teach children to win than to enjoy themselves.
Children easily imitate adults' aggressive behaviors.
explanation: Bài nói adults nên dạy trẻ tận hưởng dù thắng hay thua, không phải dạy phải thắng.

question: Câu 638: The word “self-esteem” in the passage is closest in meaning to ______.
explanation: self-esteem ≈ confidence (lòng tự trọng/tự tin).

question: Câu 639: The word “They” in the last paragraph refers to ____.
explanation: They = Parents and coaches (câu trước).

question: Câu 640: What would probably NOT be done when “facing up to a problem”?
explanation: face up to = đối mặt, không phải thờ ơ.

question: Câu 641: Which of the following is NOT true about fossil fuel?
options: We don't use much of it.
Mining fossil fuel can bring harm to the environment.
explanation: Bài nói hơn 80% năng lượng thế giới đến từ fossil fuel → dùng rất nhiều.

question: Câu 642: All of the following are true about nuclear accidents EXCEPT that ____.
options: their effects can last many years
it doesn't take us much time to clean up the nuclear waste from the accident
there were serious nuclear accidents in Ukraine in 1986 and in Japan in 2011
explanation: Japan is still trying to clean up → mất rất nhiều thời gian.

question: Câu 643: The phrase "clean up" in paragraph 3 is closest in meaning to ______.
explanation: clean up = remove (làm sạch, loại bỏ).

question: Câu 644: What does the word "They" in paragraph 4 refer to?
explanation: They = Many people don't want nuclear power = protesters.

question: Câu 645: Which of the following statements would the author of the passage support most?
options: Some governments are wrong when they are using nuclear energy.
We should consider seriously nuclear power because it has both advantages and disadvantages.
We can continue using nuclear energy until there is an accident.
Many people don't want nuclear power in their countries and governments should follow their people.
explanation: Tác giả trình bày cả ưu và nhược điểm, kêu gọi cân nhắc nghiêm túc.

question: Câu 646: You've noticed that the office printer often jams when printing large documents. What is the likely cause?
options: The printer is outdated and needs to be replaced.
The printer is not set up correctly for large document printing.
The printer is low on ink and needs to be refilled.
The paper being used is not suitable for the printer.
explanation: Nguyên nhân phổ biến nhất khi in tài liệu lớn bị kẹt là giấy không phù hợp.

question: Câu 647: Which of the following situations best exemplifies the concept of “fine” as a penalty for an offense?
options: Lisa accidentally parks in a handicap space without a permit. She realizes her mistake and pays the fine issued by the parking authority.
Lisa arrives late to a meeting and apologizes to her colleagues.
Lisa forgets to submit a report on time and promises to do better in the future.
Lisa accidentally spills water on a friend's laptop and offers to buy them coffee to make up for it.
explanation: Fine = tiền phạt. Chỉ tình huống A liên quan đến nộp tiền phạt.

question: Câu 648: Following are statements about a car. Which statement can be an opinion?
options: The car's black color is exquisite.
The car is powered by an internal combustion engine.
explanation: “exquisite” là đánh giá chủ quan → opinion.

question: Câu 649: You're at a community garden and notice that the leaves of the tomato plants are wilting in the afternoon, even though you watered them in the morning. What is the likely cause?
options: The soil isn't retaining moisture well enough.
The plants have a disease that causes wilting.
The tomatoes need less water than you're giving them.
explanation: Héo vào buổi chiều dù đã tưới sáng → đất không giữ ẩm tốt.

question: Câu 650: Which of the following situations best exemplifies the concept of a “dividend”, where someone receives a benefit or reward as a result of their actions?
options: Sarah spends a lot of time studying and gets good grades as a result of her hard work.
Sarah helps her friend move into a new apartment and receives a thank-you card in return.
Sarah invests in a company and receives regular payments based on her shares.
Sarah volunteers at a charity event and receives a certificate of appreciation for her efforts.
explanation: Dividend = cổ tức (khoản tiền nhận được từ cổ phần).
